name: Hermes Agent
description: Nous Research's self-improving agent (skills, memory, tools). Installs per user with its own pinned Python (~2 min). Gets the hotbed proxy as a named provider with every model of your provider (switch with /model); wants a model with at least 64k context.

proxy.setup: f="$HOME/.config/hotbed/agents/hermes/provider.json"; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; hermes config set providers.hotbed "$(cat "$f")" >/dev/null && hermes config set model.provider hotbed >/dev/null && hermes config set model.default {{model}} >/dev/null
